issue: What standard of appellate review applies to a district court's denial of a Franks hearing on a challenge to a warrant affidavit?

sides.position: Review the district court's conclusions of law de novo and its factual findings for clear error when reviewing the denial of a Franks hearing.
cases: United States v. Sandalo, 70 F.4th 77 (2d Cir. 2023)
United States v. Rajaratnam, 719 F.3d 139, 156 n.19 (2d Cir. 2013)

this_court: Reviews conclusions of law de novo and factual findings for clear error; the excerpt does not say how the other side of the split reviews denials of Franks hearings.
quote: While there is a circuit split on the appropriate standard of review for the denial of a Franks hearing, see United States v. Rajaratnam, 719 F.3d 139, 156 n.19 (2d Cir. 2013), and there appears to be some confusion on the matter within our own circuit
cite: United States v. Domenico Sandalo, 70 F.4th 77 (2d Cir. 2023)
